workResult: Completed source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date Selected objects without performing Research Analysis. Q-20260914-01 verified the Paperclip clean-machine failure and merged fix: a provider-valid API-key lane had been falsely denied by an unrelated local subscription-CLI probe; the correction makes admission evidence lane-specific, preserving provider re-verification for API-key execution and the CLI hello requirement for subscription execution. The bounded finding separates credential validity, host capability, execution-lane selection and business authorization. Q-20260914-02 read CoCoBench under the coordination-truth question. Its 897 oracle-validated executable tasks and four constructs—allocation, ordering, mutual exclusion and handoff—show that team reliability is construct-specific and that final task success can conceal materially different coordination failures. The bounded inference is that multi-agent reliability should be evidenced as a vector of coordination contracts rather than one scalar completion score, while transfer from executable household tasks to enterprise/software teams remains unproved. Q-20260914-03 read AgentAudit under the failure-attribution question. The framework evaluates recorded traces across ten lifecycle dimensions and reports that similar completion behavior can conceal unsafe compliance; however, a single fixed judge model creates correlated evaluator-bias and calibration limits. The bounded finding is that trace-level observability and stage attribution are necessary for trustworthy evaluation but do not themselves prove causality, current authorization or production safety. Reading created exactly three same-date Reading Notes and performed no Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication.
